verdict: ROAS held strong at 5.4x; purchase volume dipped with reduced spend.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.40 for every $1.00 spent — a healthy result on $1,484.08 in total ad spend. Purchase volume dropped week-over-week, but that decline tracks directly with a planned spend reduction; efficiency actually improved, with the most recent three days running at roughly 6.4x return compared to 4.2x the three days prior. Google Business Profile actions were quieter this past week, which we're monitoring to ensure organic visibility stays consistent with your paid activity. Four planned milestones from August remain open and are being prioritized for resolution this period, including funnel tracking and platform setup work that will sharpen our numbers going forward.
